Acme analytics pricing

Acme analytics costs £20 per seat per month on the Team plan and £45 per seat per month on the Scale plan, billed monthly with no setup fee. Both plans include unlimited cohort reports; the Scale plan adds warehouse connectors and single sign-on.

PlanPrice per seatEvents per monthWarehouse connectors
Team£2010 millionNo
Scale£45100 millionYes

Which plan should a startup choose?

Most startups under twenty people choose the Team plan, because ten million events a month covers about fifty thousand monthly active users. Move to Scale when you need warehouse sync or more than ten million events. The Acme analytics overview explains what each report shows.

Is there a free trial?

Both plans have a fourteen-day free trial with every feature switched on and no card required. At the end of the trial you choose a plan or the workspace becomes read-only, so reports you built during the trial stay available.
